```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that carbon dioxide, methane, and other greenhouse gases should be priced to reflect their negative externalities, and to accelerate the transition to a clean energy economy and help meet climate goals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that climate change is too important to wait for climate deniers and defeatists in Congress to start listening to science, and support using every tool available to reduce emissions now.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to defending, implementing, and extending smart pollution and efficiency standards, including the Clean Power Plan, fuel economy standards for automobiles and heavy-duty vehicles, building codes and appliance standards.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to expanding clean energy research and development.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats recognize the importance of climate leadership at the local level and know that achieving national clean energy goals requires an active partnership with states, cities, and rural communities where much of the country's energy policy is made.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Those taking the lead on clean energy and energy efficiency will have the tools and resources they need to succeed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should lead by example and power the government with 100 percent clean electricity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
